title: Liquidity is a state variable
body: Sample entry. We model prices as the state and liquidity as friction. But in stressed markets the causality flips: liquidity is the state, and price is just where it happens to be measured.

Sample entry. The hardest question in every applied statistics problem I've touched: what counts as one observation? Hourly pollution readings from neighboring stations are not two data points. Neither, probably, are two days of BTC returns.

title: Symmetry as prior
body: Sample entry. An invariance constraint is an infinitely strong prior. The interesting engineering question is never whether to impose it, but what evidence would make you regret it.

title: Notation debt
body: Sample entry. Bad notation compounds like bad code. Every subscript you overload today is an off-by-one error in a derivation six weeks from now.
